statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Bermuda Registrar of Companies e-Registry (https://www.roc.gov.bm / Government of Bermuda Companies Registry Portal)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: All corporate names must be in English using standard Roman characters. No diacritical marks or non-Latin scripts permitted. The name must include the words 'Limited Partnership' or the abbreviation 'L.P.' as the final element, and must not be identical or confusingly similar to an existing registered entity name in Bermuda.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: A rejected name application may be challenged by filing a written appeal with the Registrar of Companies within 14 days of the rejection notice, pursuant to the Exempted Partnerships Act 1992 Section 5. The appeal must state grounds of distinctiveness and include supporting evidence of authorized use where sensitive tokens are involved. If the Registrar upholds the rejection, the applicant may seek administrative review by the Minister of Finance within 21 days, or file a fresh application with an amended name. A name reservation may be extended once for an additional 30 days upon payment of the applicable extension fee.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Virtual office not permissible for the statutory registered office. The Exempted Partnerships Act 1992 mandates a physical registered office address in Bermuda maintained by a licensed provider. Functional back-office or remote administrative operations are acceptable, but a physical Bermuda address and local agent are mandatory.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Moderate risk for this industry. Estimated likelihood of unannounced on-site inspection within the first 12 months is 10-15%, driven by standard AML/CFT supervisory inspections by the Bermuda Monetary Authority and the Registrar of Companies, though the ISIC 3240 statue manufacturing profile carries low inherent AML risk.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Exempted Partnerships Act 2009 (ss. 1–15: registration, general partner, limited partner, registered office; s. 4 name reservation; s. 6 Declaration of Limited Partnership; s. 18 general partner duties); Business Licences Act 2009 (s. 5 business licence obligation); Exempted Undertakings Tax Protection Act 1966 (ss. 3–6 tax protection certificate); Companies (Fees) Regulations 2017 (registration fee schedule).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registrar of Companies, Department of the Registrar of Companies, Ministry of Finance, Government of Bermuda, 55 Victoria Street, Hamilton, Bermuda HM 12 (online filing portal and licensed corporate service providers).
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Form E.P. 1 — Declaration of Exempted Limited Partnership filed under s. 6 of the Exempted Partnerships Act 2009, upon acceptance of which the Registrar issues a Certificate of Registration conferring separate legal personality on the Exempted Limited Partnership.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum capital requirement; the Exempted Partnerships Act 2009 prescribes no capital floor or escrow account. Limited Partner contributions may be cash, tangible property, or services in kind. The Bermuda Monetary Authority and licensed corporate services providers may voluntarily impose an escrow or capital-call arrangement solely for FATF/AML client-onboarding purposes, not as a statutory condition.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the General Partner accepts the subscription of initial Limited Partner capital contributions, acknowledging that Bermuda law imposes no minimum statutory capital, and authorizes allotment of partnership interests accordingly. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the registered office of the Exempted Limited Partnership be established at the licensed registered agent's offices in Hamilton, Bermuda, for service of process, and be recorded with the Registrar of Companies. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the Manager and Secretary of the General Partner be appointed with authority to execute registrations, file the Business Licence application, open Stripe and PayPal merchant accounts, and obtain the tax protection endorsement. RESOLVED FINALLY, that all prior acts of the General Partner in furtherance of formation be ratified.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of Companies, Department of the Registrar of Companies, Bermuda — Registry Name Clearance Desk and online entity search portal.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the proposed English legal name for the Exempted Limited Partnership ending with 'Limited Partnership (L.P.)' or 'Exempted Limited Partnership (E.L.P.)'. Conduct a prior availability search against the active register. Provide a statutory declaration confirming no impropriety or confusing similarity and obtain the Registrar's written reservation notice.
required_dossiers: Proposed legal name (primary plus two alternates)
Draft Partnership Agreement
Statutory declaration of name propriety and non-confusion
Complex structure chart where exemption from exchange control or local ownership rules is anticipated
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused on grounds of similarity or restricted words, file a revised name or submit a notarized consent letter from the proprietor of the existing name; escalate to the Registrar under s. 4 of the Exempted Partnerships Act 2009; a final refusal is judicially reviewable in the Supreme Court of Bermuda.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Statutory Registration — Filing the Declaration of Exempted Limited Partnership
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of Companies, Bermuda — Registry Admissions Section (filed electronically via a licensed Bermuda corporate service provider or the Registry portal).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Execute and notarize Form E.P. 1 Declaration of Exempted Limited Partnership stating the ELP name, registered office, general partner details, nature of business (manufacture of polyresin display statues and garage kits), and term. Attach consents of the General Partner and registered agent, pay the statutory fee of BD$1,775, and file. Upon satisfactory review the Registrar issues the Certificate of Registration evidencing the ELP's separate legal existence.
required_dossiers: Form E.P. 1 Declaration of Exempted Limited Partnership (notarized)
Consent to act as General Partner executed by the General Partner entity
Consent to act as Registered Agent executed by the licensed agent
Proof of name reservation
Certificate of incumbency for any corporate General Partner
Proof of payment of BD$1,775 registration fee
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is queried, file a corrective amending declaration within 14 days addressing the Registrar's requisition; where registration is refused, re-file with fully cured documentation; any adverse determination is appealable to the Supreme Court of Bermuda within 21 days of notice.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Registered Office, Registered Agent and Service of Process
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of Companies, Bermuda — Registered Office and Agent Compliance Unit.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Retain a licensed Bermuda law firm or corporate management company to serve as registered agent and maintain the registered office in Hamilton. File the notice of registered office and agent appointment with the Registrar and ensure the office is open and staffed during business hours to receive process and statutory correspondence.
required_dossiers: Letter of appointment of Bermuda registered agent
Consent of registered agent to act
Registered office address acknowledgement from premises owner
Service-of-process acceptance undertaking
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Failure to maintain a registered office triggers deregistration proceedings under s. 15 of the Exempted Partnerships Act 2009; cure by reinstating a compliant office and filing Form E.P. 4 within 30 days, together with any reinstatement fee and the Registrar's statement of default.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Ministry of Finance, Government of Bermuda — Tax Commissioner's Office and Registry Tax Endorsement Desk.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File Form EUTPA-1 requesting a written undertaking under the Exempted Undertakings Tax Protection Act 1966 that protects the ELP from Bermuda income tax, capital gains tax, and dividend withholding taxes levied after 2035, provided the ELP is beneficially owned by non-residents and does not carry on business in Bermuda with local resident ownership. Attach the Certificate of Registration and the declaration of non-resident beneficial ownership.
required_dossiers: Form EUTPA-1 application for tax protection undertaking
Certificate of Registration of the Exempted Limited Partnership
Declaration of principal business conducted from outside Bermuda
Beneficial ownership schedule showing non-resident Limited Partners
Registered agent confirmation of compliance with exchange control
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Where the Ministry qualifies the undertaking owing to local ownership or local business activity, amend the ownership structure or business plan and resubmit; a contested refusal may be re-presented for ministerial review with revised declarations under s. 5 of the Exempted Undertakings Tax Protection Act 1966.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Bermuda Business Licence and Premises Regulatory Compliance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Business Licence Department, Ministry of Finance, Government of Bermuda; jointly with Department of Planning and Department of Environment and Natural Resources where a physical workshop exists in Bermuda.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the annual Business Licence application under the Business Licences Act 2009 describing the activity as 'Manufacture and Online Sale of Hand-Painted Polyresin Statues and Garage Kits — Artisan Manufacturing'. Provide revenue projections, premises information, and evidence of planning permissions and environmental registrations. The licence is renewed annually and conditioned on continued compliance with fire, building, and environmental clearances.
required_dossiers: Bermuda Business Licence application form (e-BL portal)
Projected gross revenue certification for the licence year
Copy of premises lease and Department of Planning approval (where Bermuda-based)
DENR low-impact registration acknowledgement (where applicable)
Passport copies and business references for General Partner officers
Existing EUTPA tax protection certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Business Licence is refused or conditioned restrictively, respond to the Department's objections with revised operational scope; appeals lie to the Business Licence Appeal Tribunal within 21 days of the determination; interim licences can be issued pending appeal.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Commercial Activation — Stripe and PayPal Merchant Onboarding
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Stripe, Inc. KYC Department and PayPal (UK) Ltd. Risk & Compliance teams; optional Bermuda Monetary Authority licensed EMI bank for segregated preorder deposits.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open merchant cashes under Low-Risk Standard tier using the ELP Certificate of Registration, partnership agreement, EUTPA certificate, business licence, and beneficial ownership declaration. Configure the preorder deposit rails (GBP settlement) with chargeback provisioning and AML screening. Where Regency risk dictates, establish an escrow-holding account with a BMA-licensed class E banking institution.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Registration of the ELP
Executed Partnership Agreement and beneficial ownership register
EUTPA tax protection certificate
Bermuda Business Licence
General Partner director/officer passport copies and proof of address
Projected transaction volumes and compliance questionnaire
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If KYC documentation is rejected, cure by furnishing notarized English translations, an incumbency certificate from the Bermuda registered agent, and a source-of-funds letter; alternatively, switch to a BMA-licensed EMI or licensed management company recommendation to expedite re-review.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Business Licence Department, Ministry of Finance, Bermuda (issuing authority), operating jointly with the Department of Planning and the Department of Environment and Natural Resources for any physical production site located in Bermuda.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Bermuda Business Licence — Category: Artisan/Manufacturing (Polyresin Statues and Garage Kits), issued annually under the Business Licences Act 2009, together with the EUTPA tax protection certificate and, where applicable, a Fire Safety Certificate from the Bermuda Fire and Rescue Service.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Department of Environment and Natural Resources (DENR), Environmental Protection Unit, Government of Bermuda
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category 3 — Low-Impact Registration (EIA Report Exempt). A full Environmental Impact Statement Report is mandatorily triggered only where annual resin input exceeds 5 tonnes, where solvent/VOC emissions discharge to municipal sewers is planned, or where the production site lies within a water catchment protection zone.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater: pH 6.0–9.0 and total suspended solids below 30 mg/L before sanitary sewer discharge; VOCs: styrene-equivalent ambient workplace concentration not to exceed 50 ppm per Bermuda Building Code 1990 indoor-air requirements, with mechanical ventilation and carbon filtration; hazardous waste (cured resin offcuts, MEKP catalyst containers, mixing solvents) to be consigned only to licensed waste carriers under the Waste Resource Management Rules 2008; prohibition on any ozone-depleting substance release in polyurethane/polyester casting operations.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire Safety Certificate from the Bermuda Fire and Rescue Service confirming compliance with Building Code 1990 compartmentation, smoke detection, and dual egress for the garage workshop; structural floor-loading occupancy certificate from the Department of Planning and Building certifying racking and curing-area load capacity; and a workplace operation clearance from the Department of Labour — Occupational Safety and Health (OSH) Division covering ventilation, PPE, chemical safety data sheets, and spill containment for resin catalysts.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Bermuda Office of the Tax Commissioner (OTC), Bermuda Ministry of Finance – official government tax portal; HM Customs Bermuda for indirect tax/customs matters; Registrar of Companies, Bermuda for entity registration; UK HMRC as sovereign-contact tax administration for UK VAT and cross-border trade.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign-owned Exempted Limited Partnership (ELP) must file the relevant registration forms with the Bermuda Registrar of Companies under the Limited Partnership Act 1883, resulting in an Exempted Partnership Certificate. No Bermuda TIN is issued automatically; a Payroll Tax Account must be obtained from the Office of the Tax Commissioner only if the ELP has Bermuda-resident employees or Bermuda-source remuneration. The ELP should apply to HM Customs Bermuda for an Importer/Exporter Account for customs duty and export clearance. Bermuda does not impose VAT/GST, therefore no Bermuda VAT registration is required. If the ELP voluntarily registers for UK VAT to manage UK or EU parcel deliveries, it applies through HMRC online services and receives a UK VAT registration number.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Bermuda law treats the ELP as fiscally transparent; income and gains generally flow through to partners and are not taxed at the partnership level. There is no check-the-box election in Bermuda. Where a corporate partner exists, tax is applied according to that partner's residence. The Bermuda Corporate Income Tax Act 2023, applying only to multinational enterprise groups with consolidated revenue above €750 million, permits a single filing entity election; a small resin statue garage-kit enterprise is not in scope. Hybrid mismatch elections are not available because Bermuda does not operate a general income tax for this entity type.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Bermuda Customs Duty (No VAT/GST in Bermuda; UK HMRC VAT applies at destination for UK consumer supplies)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Not applicable in Bermuda because no VAT/GST exists. A commercial business importing or exporting goods must register with HM Customs Bermuda regardless of turnover. For UK VAT purposes, an offshore seller is not automatically subject to the UK £85,000 taxable turnover threshold; import VAT and parcel consignment rules apply, including the £135 low-value consignment threshold, and a UK VAT registration may become necessary if the ELP makes relevant taxable supplies through a UK establishment or appoints a fiscal representative.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Bermuda has no real-time e-invoicing, fiscal clearance, or digital stamping mandate for domestic sales. HM Customs Bermuda requires electronic customs declarations for import/export control. For UK VAT, Making Tax Digital mandates HMRC-compatible software and digital VAT records; e-invoicing is not compulsory, but where used, the standard is UK adopted PEPPOL BIS Billing 3.0.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Bermuda imposes no VAT, so no export zero-rating is required in Bermuda; exports are outside Bermuda's indirect tax net. For UK VAT purposes, a registered UK VAT trader may zero-rate exports of goods from the UK to a non-UK destination provided the goods are exported within statutory time limits, the ELP retains contemporaneous evidence of physical export, and the supply is recorded as zero-rated in the UK VAT return. Offshore services such as statue mould design and licensing are zero-rated only if the recipient is a non-UK business and the services are used outside the UK.
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Bermuda enforces customs penalties for false export declarations, including fines up to triple the value of the merchandise and imprisonment. In the UK, HMRC may impose a penalty of up to 100% of the VAT understated or overclaimed, plus interest, and may retrospectively claw back zero-rating relief where export substantiation is inadequate. The assessment window can extend to 20 years for fraud. A false export claim also exposes the ELP to civil fraud investigation and, in egregious cases, criminal prosecution.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Bermudian dollar (BMD) is pegged at 1:1 to the United States dollar. Bermuda maintains a liberalized exchange-control regime: current-account transactions, capital movements, and profit repatriation for non-resident entities such as an Exempted Limited Partnership are fully convertible and not subject to material approval hurdles. Non-resident ELPs are able to hold foreign-currency accounts freely, and remittance of distributable profits to partners in the United Kingdom, the European Union, or other jurisdictions is permitted without exchange-control license requirements, subject only to standard banking due-diligence and AML/CFT screening through the BMA-supervised banking sector.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No statutory requirement exists for an ELP to repatriate, surrender, or convert export proceeds into BMD. Bermuda does not impose mandatory surrender timelines or conversion ratios for export receipts. Export sales denominated in USD, GBP, or EUR may be retained in the respective currency and used directly for working capital, supplier settlements, or partner distributions.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility: High for supplementary payment rails, but not as a substitute for a BMA-licensed bank account. Reputable offshore digital EMI platforms (e.g., Wise, Revolut Business, or PayPal Business) may be opened remotely for an ELP and are effective for receivables collection from retail customers in the UK/US/EU and for low-value supplier disbursements. Legal constraints: these EMIs are not regulated by the BMA; they are subject to their home-state licensing and may restrict the volume of transactions flowing from a Bermuda-domiciled entity. The ELP should maintain a genuine BMA-supervised primary account for fiduciary integrity, working capital concentration, and correspondent clearing for high-value trade payments.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Bermuda commercial banks generally require at least one general partner or a designated senior authorized signatory to attend an in-person identity and business-purpose interview at the bank’s Bermuda branch. Remote opening is available only on a strictly case-by-case basis, typically when the applicant already has an existing banking relationship, and will require enhanced due diligence including notarized constitutional documents, certified passport copies, live video verification, and an independent reference from a regulated financial institution.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Jurisdictional Mismatch Between Registered Domicile (Bermuda) and Operational Substance (UK/EU/US retail distribution)
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Bundle containing (1) certified copy of the Certificate of Limited Partnership, (2) the partnership agreement showing UK/EU general partner and Bermuda registered office, (3) current business plan describing resin statue manufacturing, international e-commerce sales, and logistics flow, (4) third-party evidence of substance in Bermuda, e.g., registered office service agreement, local professional advisor engagement, and BMA annual return filings, and (5) a written narrative of the group structure.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Source of Funds for Capital Injection and Partner Contributions
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Bundle containing (1) six months of bank statements for each contributing partner’s originating account, (2) source-of-wealth questionnaire signed by each partner, (3) supporting documentation for wealth accumulation, e.g., audited corporate accounts, tax returns, or independent financial advisor letter, and (4) notarized declaration confirming no proceeds from illegal or unlicensed financial activity are being invested.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Opaque Beneficial Ownership Structure of the Exempted Limited Partnership
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Bundle containing (1) current register of partners and beneficial owners, (2) partnership agreement sections identifying capital commitments, profit-sharing percentages, and control rights, (3) for any corporate general partner, its certificate of incorporation, register of directors, and register of members/membership interests, and (4) personal identification documents for all natural persons with 25% or greater economic interest.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Unusual Transaction Pattern or Rapid Movement of Funds Through PayPal/Stripe to Overseas Suppliers
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Bundle containing (1) projected cash-flow model matching forecasted sales to procurement spending, (2) supplier contracts or order invoices for resin, molds, pigments, and packaging materials, (3) shipping and customs entry records demonstrating genuine cross-border trade, (4) a policy narrative explaining prepayment/deposit volumes for hand-painted limited edition statues, and (5) an undertaking to provide transaction-level documentation to the bank upon request.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound partner capital contributions should be routed via SWIFT MT103 from the partner’s personal or corporate bank account in the UK/EU/US to the ELP’s Bermudian capital escrow account. Wire message must clearly state beneficiary legal name, ELP registered number, and purpose of payment. Recommended payment purpose codes for capital injection: 'CUST' or 'DEPOS' for deposits on a bank form, and in SWIFT field 70, use the narrative 'ELP CAPITAL CONTRIBUTION – PARTNERSHIP AGREEMENT DATED YYYY-MM-DD'. For amounts above the bank’s standard threshold (typically USD 250,000 or equivalent), the bank will require matching evidence from the source account, the partnership agreement, and resolution or authorization by the general partner.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Operational supplier payments and preorder deposit refunds should be cleared via SWIFT MT103 for direct beneficiary settlement. For larger purchase orders of polyresin raw materials and fabrication tooling, a commercial documentary letter of credit (usance at 30–90 days) is preferred to mitigate counterparty risk with overseas suppliers. The Bermudian banking platform will issue an irrevocable LC through its corresponding UK/US correspondent; settlement from the ELP operational account is debited at maturity. PayPal and Stripe are permitted for retail preorder and e-commerce disbursement rails but should be swept into the BMA-regulated operational account on a daily basis to maintain transparent audit trail and avoid concentration risk.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Exempted Partnership annual declaration (Form EPAD) and payment of annual government fee
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of Companies, Government of Bermuda
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before 31 January each year, covering the preceding calendar year ended 31 December
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing fee of BMD 100 per month or part month; continued default for more than 6 months may result in the Registrar issuing a notice to strike the exempted limited partnership off the register.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Beneficial ownership register annual confirmation and notification of partner or UBO changes
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Bermuda Registrar of Corporate and Business Entities (Beneficial Ownership Team)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 30 days of any transfer of an interest in the partnership or change in partners or beneficial owners; annual confirmation submitted together with the EPAD by 31 January
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-compliance is an offence punishable by a fine up to BMD 25,000, with daily default fines for the partnership and each general partner; persistent non-compliance may also trigger administrative strike-off of the partnership registration.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No compulsory independent audit exists under the Exempted Partnerships Act 1992 for a non-resident ELP unless it conducts a regulated activity (e.g., insurance, fund administration, banking) or its partnership agreement, bank financing arrangements, or investor covenants require audited financial statements.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: No Bermuda statutory accounting framework is prescribed for exempted partnerships; financial records are prepared in accordance with IFRS as adopted in the partnership agreement, with US GAAP also acceptable. No financial statements are required to be filed with the Registrar.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The general partner must maintain a Beneficial Ownership Register at the Bermuda registered office. An annual confirmation is due by 31 January, updating the beneficial ownership information for all limited partners and any Bermuda-resident controlling interest. Any transfer of an interest in the ELP, any change in the allocation of profits or voting rights, or any change in a partner's identity must be reflected in the register and notified to the Registrar within 30 days.

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% on Bermuda-source income for the Exempted Limited Partnership; a 15% Corporate Income Tax Rate under Bermuda's Corporate Income Tax Act 2023 applies only to constituent entities of MNE groups with consolidated annual revenue exceeding EUR 750 million. This entity, being a small premium resin figure producer, falls below the CITA threshold.
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: No Bermuda income tax, capital gains tax, or distribution tax for ordinary exempted partnerships. CITA in-scope groups enjoy OECD Pillar Two substance-based income exclusion and qualified refundable tax credits; a unilateral 5% tax holiday is not available.
